name: Bardejov Town Conservation Reserve
description: Bardejov is a small town in northeastern Slovakia, set in the Beskyd foothills beside the Topľa River. Its medieval centre survives almost intact, with stretches of fortified wall and a broad market square lined with colourful townhouses. Just outside the old core, a small Jewish quarter gathers around a fine 18th-century synagogue, adding another layer to the town's history.
